title: After The Rain
lyrics:
[00:00.00] 作词 : 林俊杰
[00:01.00] 作曲 : 林俊杰
[00:30.88]December
[00:33.98]Running in the rain
[00:37.83]Chasing down those memories of us
[00:41.81]Washed away
[00:45.69]Do you remember
[00:49.52]How we were together
[00:53.47]Happiness came easy
[00:55.77]With your hand in mine
[01:01.74]I’m going underwater
[01:05.40]I'm feeling needles cut through
[01:09.35]I see my world getting darker
[01:12.02]Drowning the whispers
[01:14.03]Given up on the truth 
[01:17.45]Will you take me away 
[01:19.27]After the rain
[01:20.71]Into a place we’ll never have to
[01:23.26]Bear any pain
[01:24.68]Will it ever be the same
[01:27.21]Will you feel my embrace
[01:29.20]No more sleepless nights
[01:31.09]And empty days
[01:33.63]Take me away
[01:34.95]After the rain
[01:36.26]And maybe we'll be standing with each other
[01:40.22]Hand in hand
[01:42.86]Start believing that
[01:44.30]Dreams come true
[02:00.23]I see you smiling through your eyes
[02:03.99]I look at pictures of you
[02:07.81]We won‘t give up on each other
[02:10.55]Even if it’s the last thing that I’ll do
[02:19.50]Will you take me away 
[02:21.73]After the rain
[02:22.99]Into a place we’ll never have to
[02:25.63]Bear any pain
[02:26.92]Will it ever be the same
[02:29.59]Will you feel my embrace
[02:31.57]No more sleepless nights
[02:33.35]And empty days
[02:36.00]Take me away
[02:37.33]After the rain
[02:38.63]And maybe we'll be standing with each other
[02:42.62]Hand in hand
[02:45.14]Start believing that
[02:46.79]Dreams (prayers)   come true
[02:51.00]Somewhere out there 
[02:52.09]Someone’s waiting for you
[02:58.08]I’m sure
